intent: Count catalogue product variants whose product kind is 'Hammer Measuring and Cutting Tool'.
success_criteria: Returns a single integer count of product_variants joined to product_kinds matching the kind name
Answer is bare integer in '%d' format with no surrounding text

args.stdin: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :product_kind_name
